ai_setting_limits_check.name: ai_setting_limits_check
ai_setting_limits_check.value: ("ai_setting"."max_tokens_per_run" is null or "ai_setting"."max_tokens_per_run" > 0) and ("ai_setting"."max_cost_usd_per_run" is null or "ai_setting"."max_cost_usd_per_run" > 0)

evidence_link_one_target.name: evidence_link_one_target
evidence_link_one_target.value: ("evidence_link"."engagement_requirement_id" is not null) <> ("evidence_link"."internal_framework_id" is not null and "evidence_link"."internal_code" is not null)

evidence_request_target.name: evidence_request_target
evidence_request_target.value: ("evidence_request"."internal_framework_id" is not null and "evidence_request"."internal_code" is not null) or "evidence_request"."data_item_id" is not null

evidence_version_content.name: evidence_version_content
evidence_version_content.value: ("evidence_version"."file_path" is not null and "evidence_version"."sha256" is not null) or "evidence_version"."url" is not null or "evidence_version"."data" is not null

framework_version_published_fields.name: framework_version_published_fields
framework_version_published_fields.value: "framework_version"."status" not in ('published', 'retired') or ("framework_version"."published_at" is not null and "framework_version"."published_by" is not null)

milestone_engagement_template_key_idx.name: milestone_engagement_template_key_idx
milestone_engagement_template_key_idx.where: "milestone"."template_key" is not null and "milestone"."recurrence" is null
